title: An Upper Bound on Grothendieck's Constant
summary: We show that Grothendieck's real constant $K_G$ can be upper bounded by projecting vectors onto a random plane through the origin and thresholding a degree five Hermite polynomial. This resolves a conjecture of Braverman-Makarychev-Makarychev-Naor from 2011, who required an extra randomization step in their rounding scheme and proved $K_G<\fracπ{2\log(1+\sqrt{2})}-10^{-500}$. As a corollary of our result, we prove the bound $K_G<\fracπ{2\log(1+\sqrt{2})}-10^{-217}$ by thresholding degree three Hermite polynomials in the plane.
